verses.saheeh: When the sky has split [open]
verses.khattab: When the sky bursts open
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When the heaven is rent asunder,

verses.saheeh: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.khattab: obeying its Lord as it must
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and heeds, gives ear to and, in rending itself asunder, obeys, its Lord as it should, that is, as its duty is to heed and obey,

verses.saheeh: And when the earth has been extended
verses.khattab: and when the earth is flattened out
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the earth is stretched out, [when] its width is increased, just as a piece of leather is stretched, so that no edifice or mountain remains upon it,

verses.saheeh: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
verses.khattab: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and casts out all that is in it, of the dead, onto its surface, and empties itself, thereof,

verses.saheeh: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
verses.khattab: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and heeds, [and] in this respect, gives ear to and obeys, its Lord, as it should: all of this will be on the Day of Resurrection (the response to idhā, ‘when’, and [to] all that is supplemented thereto, has been omitted; but it is indicated by what follows it, and is implied to be [something like] laqiya’l-insānu ‘amalahu, ‘man will encounter his deeds’).

verses.uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
verses.indopak: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الْاِنْسَانُ اِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلٰقِيْهِۚ
verses.transliteration: ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi
verses.saheeh: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
verses.khattab: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences
verses.jalalayn: ﻿O man! Verily you are labouring, exerting your efforts, toward, the encounter with, your Lord, that is, death, laboriously, and you will encounter it, that is, you will encounter your mentioned good or evil deeds on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.transliteration: fa amma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi
verses.saheeh: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
verses.khattab: As for those who are given their record in their right hand
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then as for him who is given his book, the record of his deeds, in his right hand — and this is the believer —

verses.saheeh: He will be judged with an easy account
verses.khattab: they will have an easy reckoning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿he will receive an easy reckoning, which [simply] entails the presentation of his deeds to him, as in the hadīth of the two Sahīhs [of Bukhārī and Muslim] — in which there is also [a hadīth saying], ‘He who is reckoned with at length, will be destined for perdition’ — and after this presentation [of his deeds to the believer] he will be excused,

verses.saheeh: And return to his people in happiness.
verses.khattab: and will return to their people joyfully
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and return to his family, in Paradise, joyful, because of it.

verses.uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
verses.indopak: وَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوْتِىَ كِتٰبَهٗ وَرَاۤءَ ظَهْرِهٖۙ
verses.saheeh: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
verses.khattab: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But as for him who is given his book from behind his back — and this is the disbeliever, whose right hand is chained to his neck and whose left hand, by which he is given the book, is placed behind his back,

verses.saheeh: He will cry out for destruction
verses.khattab: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction
verses.jalalayn: ﻿he will pray, upon seeing what is in it, for annihilation, he will invoke destruction against himself by saying: yā thabūrāh, ‘O annihilation [of mine]!’,

verses.saheeh: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
verses.khattab: and will burn in the blazing Fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and he will enter the Blaze, an intense fire (a variant reading [for yaslā, ‘he will enter’] has yusallā, ‘he will be admitted’).

verses.saheeh: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
verses.khattab: For they used to be prideful among their people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed among his folk, his clan, in the world, he used to be joyful, wanton, lusting after his desires;

verses.saheeh: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
verses.khattab: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿indeed he thought that (an: softened in place of the hardened form, with its subject omitted, that is to say, annahu) he would never return, to his Lord.

verses.transliteration: bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran
verses.saheeh: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
verses.khattab: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay!, he will return to Him; indeed his Lord is ever Seer of him, knowing that he would return to Him.

verses.saheeh: So I swear by the twilight glow
verses.khattab: So, I do swear by the twilight
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So I swear (fa-lā: lā is extra) by the twilight (al-shafaq), the reddishness visible in the horizon after the sunset,

verses.saheeh: And [by] the night and what it envelops
verses.khattab: And by the night and whatever it envelops
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the night and what it envelops, [what] it brings together of creatures and otherwise that have entered into it,

verses.saheeh: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
verses.khattab: And by the moon when it waxes full
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the moon when it is at the full, and its light is complete, and this happens during the nights of the full moon:

verses.saheeh: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
verses.khattab: You will certainly pass from one state to another
verses.jalalayn: ﻿you will surely journey (tarkabunna is actually tarkabūnanna, but the nūn of the indicative has been omitted because of two identical letters following one another, and the wāw [is omitted] because of two unvocalised consonants coming together), from stage to stage, state after state, namely, death, then life, then what comes afterwards of the states at the Resurrection.

verses.saheeh: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
verses.khattab: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So what is wrong with them, that is, the disbelievers, that they do not have faith, that is to say, what is there to prevent them from [embracing] faith; or what argument do they have for neglecting it despite the existence of proofs for it,

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَ۩
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْاٰنُ لَا يَسْجُدُوْنَۗ۩
verses.saheeh: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
verses.khattab: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and, what is wrong with them, that when the Qur'an is recited to them they do not prostrate?, they [do not] submit by believing in it, given its inimitability?

verses.saheeh: But those who have disbelieved deny,
verses.khattab: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but the disbelievers deny, resurrection and other matters,

verses.saheeh: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
verses.khattab: But Allah knows best whatever they hide
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and God knows best what they are amassing, accumulating in their scrolls, in the way of disbelief, denial and evil deeds.

verses.saheeh: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
verses.khattab: So give them good news of a painful punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So give them good tidings, inform them, of a painful chastisement,

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُوْنٍ٪
verses.transliteration: illa allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin
verses.saheeh: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
verses.khattab: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except those who believe and perform righteous deeds: theirs will be an unfailing reward, one that is unending, undiminished and not given to them in expectance of anything in return.
